watch.2: the workshop's build log, and the game room's high-score board

lines: The housing from the shack ({date}) fits rig seven. Badly. Good.
Rig seven ran six hours last night and stopped. I am not telling you why. I don't know why yet.

spot.line: Rig seven sits on the shelf now, lid off, a strip of tape across it: "stopped 6h. not broken. thinking."

lines: Game room. The board is still there. Beat me first. Or try: trying counts as data.
